fields.name: Oneplus Nord CE6
fields.description:
The Nord CE6 has the same basic design, build quality, and display as the Nord 6. It does, however, get a Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, one fewer cameras on the back, a smaller (but still quite large) 8,000mAh battery, as well as trimmed down memory and storage configurations. Also, that display only goes up to 144Hz now instead of 165Hz, but you are not going to notice that. The result is a device that is a curious and rather controversial conglomeration, with on-paper specs that often seem worse than even its own predecessors. Can a big battery and sturdy build really make up for that? Let's find out.

The Nord CE6 shares the same basic frame as the Nord 6. The two phones have identical dimensions, nearly identical weight (off by 2g), and an almost identical layout for everything you see along the sides, including the buttons, the ports, and the SIM tray pinhole that is nearly indistinguishable from the microphone.

The main difference comes from the camera layout on the back. The Nord CE6 has a cleaner camera layout, thanks to having one less camera, and the resultant design ends up looking a bit more elegant on account of its simplicity. You can see the only real usable camera on the top left, the depth sensor below, and the LED flash and IR blaster in a small pill-shaped window next to them.

The back features a matte texture, but there is a thin glossy strip that runs along the edge, a detail borrowed from the OnePlus 15. You won't find that on Nord 6.

fields.name: Samsung S25
fields.description:
The S25 Ultra has gotten thinner, narrower, and lighter than the S24 Ultra, but thanks to the shrunken bezels, there is now a larger 6.9-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X screen with 1440p resolution.

Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite powers all S25 models, Ultra included, which is the most welcome generational upgrade this year. The most powerful Android chip to date is "for Galaxy" version, which means it features a boosted CPU, because that is what Samsung and Qualcomm do.

All cameras across all Galaxy S25 models stay the same as on their S24 counterparts except for the ultrawide unit in the S25 Ultra, which now has a 50MP sensor with an f/1.9 aperture (and autofocus, still). The 200MP primary, the 10MP 3x and 50MP 5x telephoto cameras, as well as the 12MP selfie shooter, are all without hardware upgrades. Samsung is relying on the power of the new Snapdragon chipset's ISP to improve the photo and video quality across the board.

The best remote shooter in the world is gone, but the best Galaxy in the world is back! Headlining the new series, the Galaxy S25 Ultra brings numerous design, performance, camera, and, of course, AI updates, but takes away arguably the most loved S-Pen feature - the Bluetooth connectivity.

Samsung has finally struck gold with the Galaxy S25 Ultra design - now there is a flat frame with rounded corners, which should improve both looks and handling experience. The phone's front is even tougher this time with second-generation Gorilla Glass Armor and grade 5 titanium frame.

fields.name: Iphone 17 Pro Max
fields.description:
The usual chip and connectivity updates are here courtesy of the Apple A19 Pro SoC, the base memory has been upped to 256 GB for the rest of the lineup, while the Pro Max which was already there last year gains a new 2 TB storage option. The battery life got better, the charging got faster, and iOS got more features.
The two major camera upgrades include a new 18MP Center Stage selfie camera with a square (not quite, but we'll get to that later) sensor and multi-aspect shooting, and a new 48 MP telephoto camera with 4x optical zoom. Oh, and you can now capture 4K120 Dolby Vision clips.

The new signature color is Cosmic orange, which will be familiar to the veterans in the industry from the Nokia N8. Fun fact: that one used anodized aluminum much like the iPhone Pros of this year.
It was about time Apple stopped with the iterative updates and shook things up. And one thing is certain - nothing will be the same as before, for better or worse.
The 17 series see the Pro models switch to an aluminum unibody for the first time, helping keep weight in check and improving heat dissipation. While this was done for practical reasons, the years of hyping steel and titanium may come to bite Apple.

fields.name: Macbook Pro
fields.description:
Macbook pro with Apple Silicon is the best productivity device. Run graphics-intensive workflows with responsiveness that keeps up with your imagination. Each chip in the M5 family features a GPU with enhanced shader cores and a third-generation ray‑tracing engine, so 3D modelling is crisper and clearer than ever. And Dynamic Caching optimises on-chip memory to significantly increase GPU utilisation — driving huge performance boosts for pro apps and games.

M5 Pro delivers even more power for scientists, engineers, software developers and creative pros tackling intensive projects.
Available in MacBook Pro 14″ and 16″ Up to 7.8x faster than M1 Pro macbooks.

fields.name: Hawkins Cooker
fields.description: Elevate your culinary endeavors with the Hawkins Triply Stainless Steel Classic Pressure Cooker in elegant silver. The cookware delivers even heat distribution, helping prevent burning and ensuring consistent results every time. Designed for both gas stove and induction cooktops, the set fits seamlessly into modern kitchens while maintaining a traditional cooking experience. The ergonomic wooden-look handles offer a comfortable, secure grip and add an elegant touch to your kitchen. Durable, hygienic, and easy to maintain, this cookware set is ideal for daily Indian cooking—bringing together performance, style, and convenience in one smart combo.
